title: Item state timers re-anchor on transitions that do not restate the duration
description:
Every operation transition re-resolves the entered state's timer declarations, and reconcileItemStateTimers replaces the prior deadline (packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts selectStateTransition + line ~2061). A self-transition that the source does not describe as restating the duration therefore extends it.

Confirmed for Cube of Force (eshyra-0p7c): press-face-1 at minute 0 anchors the barrier timer at deadline 1; firing 'spell-contact-loss' (a free reaction to a listed spell contacting the barrier, from face-N to face-N) at minute 1 re-anchors it to deadline 2. SRD 5.1 resets the duration only when 'pressing a different face of the cube and expending the requisite number of charges'; a spell contact only deducts charges. Repeated contacts can extend the barrier indefinitely.

Same class, pre-existing: Ring of Shooting Stars declares 'active' -> 'active' via move-ball-lightning (bonus action) alongside a 1-minute timer, so moving a sphere extends the one-minute window.

Expected: a transition should be able to enter/re-enter a state without re-anchoring that state's pending timers, defaulting to preserving the existing deadline unless the source restates the duration. Likely needs a schema-level marker on the transition (or on the timer) plus itemState/itemTimers support, and source-backed curation of which existing transitions reset.

Files: packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts, packages/core/src/state/itemTimers.ts, packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts, packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts. Tests: packages/core/test/itemState.test.ts, packages/core/test/itemTimers.test.ts.
notes:
## Supervisor design decision (2026-07-21)

Chosen model: **state-scoped timers are preserved on re-entry by default; a
transition opts in to restating the duration.**

- Timers are already state-scoped (`reconcileItemStateTimers` drops timers whose
  `from` !== entered state), so a cross-state transition necessarily anchors
  fresh and is already correct. The defect is confined to transitions whose
  destination equals the current `machineState`.
- Rule: when `selectedTransition.nextState === state.machineState`, each declared
  timer of that state that is already pending (same `from` + `to`) keeps its
  existing `anchorElapsedMinutes` / `deadlineElapsedMinutes` / `roll`, unless the
  transition declares `resetsDuration: true`.
- New schema key `resetsDuration?: true` on `stateMachine.transitions[]`, legal
  only when `from === to`. `false` is rejected (it is the default; no dead
  declarations).
- Dice-defined timers must NOT be re-rolled when preserved (no RNG consumption).

### Source-backed curation (SRD 5.1, all three affected machines)

| item | self-transition | ruling |
|---|---|---|
| Cube of Force | `face-N --press-face-N--> face-N` | **resetsDuration: true** — "press one of the cube's faces... a barrier of invisible force springs into existence... and lasts for 1 minute" applies to any face press |
| Cube of Force | `face-N --spell-contact-loss--> face-N` | preserve — source only says "The cube loses charges when the barrier is targeted by certain spells"; no duration language |
| Bead of Force | `sphere --move-force-sphere--> sphere` | preserve — "encloses the area for 1 minute"; pushing the wall only moves the sphere |
| Ring of Shooting Stars | `active --move-ball-lightning--> active` | preserve — "last as long as you concentrate... up to 1 minute"; moving is a bonus action |

Cross-face presses (`face-N -> face-M`, M != N) keep re-anchoring, which is the
source behaviour ("pressing a different face... resetting the duration").

### Acceptance criteria

1. Repeated `spell-contact-loss` cannot extend the Cube of Force barrier.
2. Bead of Force / Ring of Shooting Stars self-transitions preserve the deadline.
3. `press-face-N` from `face-N` still re-anchors, via the explicit marker.
4. Schema rejects `resetsDuration` on a non-self transition and rejects `false`.
5. Generated pack regenerated through the importer; diff limited to the three
   machines; `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` clean.
6. `npm run verify:worktree` clean.

### Out of scope (decided)

- `itemResetExecutor.applyDueTimer` is timer-fired only and re-anchors the
  entered state's timers deliberately (it also guards against non-advancing
  timers); no change.
- No new field on `UseItemResult['transition']` — the persisted
  `state.pendingTimers` deadline is already the observable.
- `docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json` records.json hash
  already mismatches on `main` (thawed re-audit, re-freeze is eshyra-o9bd.14).
  Do not "fix" the manifest here.
